title: feat(smtp,mail): List/* mailbox auto-creation from List-Id: header
description:
Email carrying a List-Id: header (RFC 2919) is mailing list traffic and should be sorted into List/<list-name> rather than INBOX. The List/* mailboxes must be auto-created on first delivery so operators do not need to configure them manually.

What needs to be done:
1. In the SMTP delivery path (after Sieve evaluation), extract the List-Id: header value; normalize to a safe mailbox name (strip angle brackets, replace . with / or keep flat — decision needed).
2. Auto-create List/<name> mailbox (JMAP + IMAP visible) if it does not exist; assign a stable ID derived from (user_id, list_id).
3. Deliver the message to List/<name> instead of INBOX.
4. Expose List/<name> in IMAP LIST with \\HasNoChildren and in JMAP Mailbox/get with parentId=<list-root-id>.
5. Add tests: SMTP delivery of a List-Id: bearing message lands in List/<name>, not INBOX; second delivery to same list reuses existing mailbox.
